blocks.text: The daily administrative burden in risk management

You likely spend your day moving between GRC platforms like LogicManager or Resolver and your local Mac apps. This context switching creates a significant cognitive load. You are not just analyzing risk. You are chasing control owners, verifying evidence, and formatting reports for stakeholders. This invisible overhead adds up quickly.
How to use risk assessment software tools with Lazur

Lazur sits in your Mac notch, ready to help when you are. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about any element on your screen. If you are lost in a complex Excel risk register, ask Lazur to explain what a specific menu path does. It will draw a circle around the button or menu item you need.
Always follow your organization's specific policies regarding the handling of sensitive client or patient data. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio after the request is answered.

blocks.text: Outlook is often where your day stalls. You receive requests for risk updates and must translate those into tasks. Instead of typing every response, hold the fn key to dictate your replies. Lazur captures your voice and turns it into clean, formatted text directly in the email body.

blocks.text: Analyzing data in Excel for risk management

Excel remains the primary tool for ad hoc risk analysis. When you need to calculate a percentage change or add a trendline to a risk heat map, you might forget the exact path. Use Lazur to guide you through the ribbon menus without leaving your spreadsheet.

If you are stuck on a formula, ask Lazur to explain the syntax. It will walk you through the logic, step by step. You stay in your flow while Lazur provides the technical details you need to keep moving.
Why administrative work feels so heavy

Many firms still rely on manual processes for evidence collection. This creates an automation gap. You end up spending hours on tasks that could be faster if you had the right support. Lazur helps you close this gap by reducing the time you spend on repetitive navigation and text entry.

Reports for the board or risk committee require high precision. When drafting these in Word, you need to ensure your formatting is perfect. Use Lazur to apply heading styles or add page numbers by asking out loud. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your focus on the content.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with all GRC platforms?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac regardless of the app. It sees your screen and helps you navigate menus or draft text in any web-based GRC platform or desktop application.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur for risk reports?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It is designed for privacy and does not use your data to train any AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Excel files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit your files for you. It explains how to use features and guides you through the steps so you remain in control of your work.
